sloka: द्रष्टुं त्वां काङ्क्षते राजा सर्वराक्षसपुङ्गवः ।गमने क्रियतां बुद्धिर्भ्रातरं सम्प्रहर्षय ।। ६.६०.९० ।।।।
transliteration: draṣṭuṁ tvāṁ kāṅkṣate rājā sarvarākṣasapuṅgavaḥ ।gamane kriyatāṁ buddhirbhrātaraṁ sampraharṣaya ।। 6.60.90 ।।।।

translations.english: Joyful Kumbhakarna, washed his face, had a bath and being thirsty ordered a drink that can increase his strength.
